The man will likely prevail. The express easement was extinguished by merger when he acquired the woman's house, and his later warranty deed did not revive it, while the marked path supports at most an implied prior-use easement, which fails because a shorter route is not "reasonably necessary." I don't think the team note's second option holds, since merger isn't undone by the unity being brief, and recording gives notice without creating an easement.

CONFIDENCE: 65
